scope: Read-only independent production worker integration/lifecycle review. No edit, build, GPU or runtime operation.

findings.issue: Wider worker_prepare includes final surface acquisition time: turn clock starts before get_current_texture and is summed after job.advance. Ordinary draw starts its preparation clock after acquisition. If acquisition paces or blocks, the displayed CPU preparation value combines CPU encoding and presentation waiting, so it is not directly comparable with ordinary mode CPU preparation.
findings.recommendation: Measure acquisition separately, start/accumulate encoding preparation outside that interval, or label the metric explicitly as active worker wall time.

findings.issue: Wider Published updates NativeDiagnostics submitted/full_submitted counters but never invokes NativeDiagnostics::report_if_due. Its sole production call is ordinary draw at1264. A workload consisting entirely of RGB666/RGB777 frames therefore stops emitting the worker civ3r-profile-v1 cadence and its adapter/submission/epoch observations, although generic Profile reports continue.
findings.recommendation: Invoke the periodic worker diagnostic after the renderer is recovered on WiderProgress::Published, with an explicit unavailable GPU timing representation.

explicit_limits.limit: Existing once-per-frame scene preparation remains outside continuation encode quotas. set_world packs/clones/uploads scene records and first_zoomed can be quadratic over distinct metadata keys; update/free/marker/patch setup also scales with input. This is not new CPU pixel composition, not repeated per chunk, and not an encode cursor violation. Whole production-frame CPU latency is not bounded by128 pieces/2048 visits.

Existing optional diagnostic Bitmap path maps/copies pixels and converts channel layout on CPU, bounded by64MiB. Pixel composition remains GPU; this review does not classify that OS transport as a new software rasterizer.

verified_properties: One PendingWider pins one immutable Arc<Frame> and takes ownership of TileRenderer. No art/timing/scene mutation is applied while active.

Future Frame/Art/Config remain in Latest; frame/art inputs coalesce, config revision invalidation cancels before configuration. Producer updates do not repeatedly restart a frame except invalidating configurations.
Every turn polls device nonblocking; advance also performs one Poll. Ready work skips4ms park; Backpressure parks briefly and callbacks atomically release the shared3-chunk window and ring actor.

Target acquired only after NeedsTarget; only Published produces Presented or starts final Bitmap readback. Main input mapping commits only matching final completion. complete_frame drops immutable frame before waking UI.

Resize/surface errors cancel jobs, invalidate world_version, and preserve previous published picture. DeviceError cancels and drops frame before error; stopping drops State/job safely without waits and wgpu retains submitted resources.

Retired/current wider work uses one shared completion window. Canvas/source spares carry last-use tags; unsubmitted replacements are not retained, avoiding cancellation-storm accumulation. No newly introduced whole-world clone per chunk or explicit mutex found.

GPU unavailable notification and timing token floors suppress delayed old/untokened samples; gap anchors reset. Main clears detailed GPU timing before first wider marker snapshot after its world is constructed.
acceptance: No blocking integration/lifecycle issue found in this source-only review. P2 metric/telemetry issues and baseline setup limits remain. No compile, SPIR-V, numeric correctness, runtime, memory measurement or performance acceptance.
